summary:
Enter in the agenda app now jumps to the earliest later day that has an event, and stays put if none exists. The original agenda tests and two new ones for the Enter key pass (2 of 2 each).

The change is a new `or when k is 'enter'` branch in the key task of `desk:apps:agenda` (lines 14–27). The new tests are in `desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests`, a page I added to the drawer. The app never reads `desk:apps`, and no page there has a `#end` line.

files.desk:apps:agenda:
app 'Agenda'
task start()
  set events to []
  for each p in pages('calendar')
    add fields(p) to events
  done
  give {events: events, day: today()}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'right'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, 1)
  or when k is 'left'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, -1)
or when k is 'enter'
set best to ''
for each e in s.events
when e.date > s.day
when best is ''
set best to e.date
or when e.date < best
set best to e.date
done
done
done
when best > ''
set s.day to best
done
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change the day')
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'
fixed e1 is 'date: 2026-12-05' & newline() & 'time: 15:00'
fixed e2 is 'date: 2026-12-03' & newline() & 'time: 09:30'
fixed f1 is 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00'
fixed f2 is 'date: 2026-11-30' & newline() & 'time: 09:30'
test 'enter goes to the earliest later day that has an event'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
pretend 'calendar:e1' holds e1 & newline() & 'title: Dentist'
pretend 'calendar:e2' holds e2 & newline() & 'title: Standup'
launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-03 thursday'
check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
done
test 'enter does nothing when no later day has an event'
pretend today is '2026-12-01'
pretend 'calendar:e1' holds f1 & newline() & 'title: Dentist'
pretend 'calendar:e2' holds f2 & newline() & 'title: Standup'
launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
check screen_line(3) is '15:00 Dentist'
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

test 'it shows the events of today, by time'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00' & newline() & 'title: Dentist' & newline() & 'with: '
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 09:30' & newline() & 'title: Standup' & newline() & 'with: team'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
  check screen_line(4) is '15:00 Dentist'
done

test 'right goes to the next day'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'right'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-02 wednesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '(no events)'
done
